## Post-edit verification

**Tier 1 (automated)**
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format passes
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] E2E tests pass
- [ ] All imports resolve to actual files
- [ ] Changes are within stated task scope

**Tier 1.5 (AI guardrails -- if AI was used)**
- [ ] AI usage noted in AI disclosure section below
- [ ] Tests existed BEFORE AI generated implementation
- [ ] No new dependencies without team agreement
- [ ] No new abstractions without justification
- [ ] Design tokens used (no hardcoded colors/spacing)
- [ ] Environment tool used for all commands (no raw shell)

**Tier 2 (UI/accessibility changes only)**
- [ ] Keyboard-only walkthrough
- [ ] Screen reader spot-check (tested with: ___)
- [ ] Semantic HTML used (no ARIA where native elements work)
- [ ] Voice Control spot-check (if header/nav changed)
- [ ] High-contrast mode check
- [ ] Reduced-motion behavior verified
- [ ] Touch targets >= minimum size

**Tier 3 (new features / major changes only)**
- [ ] OSS-first search completed and documented
- [ ] Feature flag added (if applicable)
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry drafted
